replay.python:
import os
from pathlib import Path
from r2b import AnalysisOptions, analyze
from r2b.config import AppConfig

binary = Path(os.environ.get('R2B_INPUT', '/tmp/r2b-case-studies/rpcd/sbin/rpcd'))
expected_sha256 = 'ac6f18d11fe3d13ad5cd11ebf06861cb28b9464053351078020a7562ef9879ee'
config = AppConfig.model_validate({'analysis': {'enable_angr': False, 'enable_ghidra': False, 'enable_frida': False, 'enable_gef': False, 'gef_timeout': 60, 'gef_max_instructions': 10000, 'require_elf': False}, 'extract': {'enable': False, 'extract_elf': False, 'allow_unsafe_fallback': False, 'timeout_s': 60, 'max_files': 200, 'max_bytes': 67108864, 'max_depth': 2}, 'performance': {'parallel_functions': 4}, 'ghidra': {'use_bridge': False, 'max_decompile_functions': 20, 'max_types': 100, 'max_strings': 200}})
report = analyze(
    binary,
    config=config,
    options=AnalysisOptions(
        profile='triage',
        extract=False,
    ),
)
assert report.payload['provenance']['input']['sha256'] == expected_sha256
print(report.briefing['summary'])
